### Q1. JEE Main 2025 (29 Jan Shift 1)

*Type:* `singleCorrect` | *Difficulty Level:* `3`

The reaction \(\mathrm{A}_2+\mathrm{B}_2 \rightarrow 2 \mathrm{AB}\) follows the mechanism
<img src='data:image/png;base64,'>
The overall order of the reaction is :

**Options:**

- **(A)** 2
- **(B)** 2.5
- **(C)** 3
- **(D)** 1.5

<details>
<summary><b>View Answer & Solution</b></summary>

**Correct Option:** **(D) 1.5**

**Detailed Solution:**

$\begin{aligned}
& \text { rate }=\mathrm{k}_2[\mathrm{~A}]\left[\mathrm{B}_2\right] \ldots \ldots \\
& \left(\frac{\mathrm{k}_1}{\mathrm{k}_{-1}}\right)=\left(\frac{[\mathrm{A}]^2}{\left[\mathrm{~A}_2\right]}\right) \\
& \Rightarrow[\mathrm{A}]=\sqrt{\frac{\mathrm{k}_1}{\mathrm{k}_{-1}}} \cdot \sqrt{\left[\mathrm{~A}_2\right]}
\end{aligned}$

Substituting in (1) ; we get


$\begin{aligned} & \text { Rate }=\mathrm{k}_2 \sqrt{\frac{\mathrm{k}_1}{\mathrm{k}_{-1}}} \cdot\left[\mathrm{~A}_2\right]^{\frac{1}{2}} \cdot\left[\mathrm{~B}_2\right] \\ & \therefore \text { order }=\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)=1.5\end{aligned}$

</details>

### Q2. JEE Main 2025 (24 Jan Shift 2)

*Type:* `singleCorrect` | *Difficulty Level:* `2`

Given below are two statements :
<img src="https://cdn-question-pool.getmarks.app/pyq/jee_main/4xR3Wy74WEdXd4FpGWx9L3qF84t5irCqTrjXhQ38UHc.original.fullsize.png"/>

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below :

**Options:**

- **(A)** Both Statement I and Statement II are true
- **(B)** Statement I is false but Statement II is true
- **(C)** Statement I is true but Statement II is false
- **(D)** Both Statement I and Statement II are false

<details>
<summary><b>View Answer & Solution</b></summary>

**Correct Option:** **(C) Statement I is true but Statement II is false**

**Detailed Solution:**

For first order reaction $\mathrm{t}_{1 / 2}=\frac{\ell \mathrm{n} 2}{\mathrm{k}}$


<img src="https://cdn-question-pool.getmarks.app/pyq/jee_main/DH6NCmbR_FZZ27YdkgZxUvvwqnQHTln86y4S8_HyuPE.original.fullsize.png">


For first order reaction
$\begin{aligned}
& \log \frac{[R]_0}{[R]}=\frac{1}{2.303} \mathrm{kt} \\
& \log \frac{[\mathrm{R}]_0}{[\mathrm{R}]}=\left(\frac{\mathrm{k}}{2.303}\right) \times \mathrm{t}
\end{aligned}$<img src="https://cdn-question-pool.getmarks.app/pyq/jee_main/jOX6ZyJ2tnr3jL4irMAWnHe2wMZ6oetL9fM6fJiBD2w.original.fullsize.png">

</details>

### Q3. JEE Main 2024 (06 Apr Shift 1)

*Type:* `numerical` | *Difficulty Level:* `1`

Time required for \(99.9 \%\) completion of a first order reaction is _______ times the time required for completion of \(90 \%\) reaction.(nearest integer)

<details>
<summary><b>View Answer & Solution</b></summary>

**Correct Value:** **3**

**Detailed Solution:**

$\begin{aligned} & \mathrm{K}=\frac{1}{\mathrm{t}_{99.9 \%}} \ln \left(\frac{100}{0.1}\right)=\frac{1}{\mathrm{t}_{90 \%}} \ln \left(\frac{100}{10}\right) \\ & \mathrm{t}_{99.9 \%}=\mathrm{t}_{90 \%} \frac{\ell \mathrm{n}\left(10^3\right)}{\ell \mathrm{n} 10} \\ & \mathrm{t}_{99.9 \%}=\mathrm{t}_{90 \%} \times 3\end{aligned}$

</details>

### Q5. JEE Main 2023 (29 Jan Shift 2)

*Type:* `numerical` | *Difficulty Level:* `1`

For conversion of compound <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mo>&#8594;</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></math>, the rate constant of the reaction was found to be <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>&#215;</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow></msup><mo>&#160;</mo><mi>Lmol</mi><mmultiscripts><mo>&#160;</mo><mprescripts/><none/><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mmultiscripts><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>. The order of the reaction is _____ .

<details>
<summary><b>View Answer & Solution</b></summary>

**Correct Value:** **2**

**Detailed Solution:**

<p>Rate(r) <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi><msup><mfenced open="[" close="]"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></msup></math></p><p><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>&#8658;</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mi>rate</mi><msup><mfenced open="[" close="]"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></msup></mfrac></math></p><p>Unit of rate constant is related to order of reaction<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mo>)</mo></math> by the relation: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mi>conc</mi><mo>.</mo></mrow></mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></mrow></msup><msup><mi>time</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math></p><p>Thus,
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnalign="right"><mtr><mtd><mo>&#8658;</mo><mfenced><msup><mi>Lmol</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mfenced><mo>&#8658;</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></math></p>

</details>

### Q9. JEE Main 2022 (25 Jul Shift 1)

*Type:* `numerical` | *Difficulty Level:* `1`

The half life for the decomposition of gaseous compound <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>240</mn><mo>&#160;</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></math> when the gaseous pressure was <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>500</mn></math> Torr initially. When the pressure was <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>250</mn></math> Torr, the half life was found to be <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>&#160;</mo><mi>min</mi></math>. The order of the reaction is _____ (Nearest integer)

<details>
<summary><b>View Answer & Solution</b></summary>

**Correct Value:** **1**

**Detailed Solution:**

<blockquote><p><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mfenced><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></msub></mfenced><mrow><mn>500</mn><mo>&#160;</mo><mi>torr</mi></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>240</mn><mi>sec</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>&#160;</mo><mi>min</mi></math></p><p><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mfenced><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></msub></mfenced><mrow><mn>250</mn><mo>&#160;</mo><mi>torr</mi><mo>&#160;</mo></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>&#160;</mo><mi>min</mi><mo>.</mo></math></p><p><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></msub><mo>&#8733;</mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></mrow></msup></math></p><p><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><msub><mfenced><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mstyle></msub></mfenced><mn>1</mn></msub><msub><mfenced><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></msub></mfenced><mn>2</mn></msub></mfrac><mo>=</mo><msup><mfenced><mfrac><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mfrac></mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></mrow></msup><mspace linebreak="newline"></mspace><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>0</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mfenced><mfrac><mn>250</mn><mn>500</mn></mfrac></mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></mrow></msup><mspace linebreak="newline"></mspace><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math></p><p>As <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></msub></math> is independent of initial pressure. Hence, order is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn></math>st order.</p></blockquote>

</details>

The order of the above reactions are <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mo>,</mo><mo>&#160;</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi><mo>,</mo><mo>&#160;</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mo>&#160;</mo><mi>and</mi><mo>&#160;</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mo>,</mo></math>respectively. Which one of the following statements is correct?

**Options:**

- **(A)** Order of the reaction with respect to <math><mi>B</mi></math>  is  <math><mn>2</mn></math>
- **(B)** Total order of the reaction is <math><mn>4</mn></math>
- **(C)** Order of the reaction with respect to <math><mi>A</mi></math>  is <math><mn>2</mn></math>
- **(D)** Order of the reaction with respect to <math><mi>B</mi></math> is <math><mn>1</mn></math>

<details>
<summary><b>View Answer & Solution</b></summary>

**Correct Option:** **(A) Order of the reaction with respect to <math><mi>B</mi></math>  is  <math><mn>2</mn></math>**

**Detailed Solution:**

<blockquote><p><math><mn>2</mn><mi>A</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>B</mi><mo>&#8594;</mo><mi>C</mi></math>

Initial <math><msub><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mi>k</mi><msup><mrow><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mi>A</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup><msup><mrow><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mi>B</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>0.3</mn><mi>&#160;</mi><mrow><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow><mo>/</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi></mrow></mrow></math> ...(i)

<math><msub><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mi>k</mi><msup><mrow><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>A</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup><msup><mrow><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>B</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>2.4</mn></math> ...(ii)

<math><msub><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mi>k</mi><msup><mrow><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>A</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup><msup><mrow><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mi>B</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>0.6</mn></math> ...(iii)

From (i) <math><mo>&#247;</mo></math> (iii)

<math><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>0.3</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>0.6</mn></mrow></mfrac></math>

<math><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></math>

<math><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math>

(ii) <math><mo>&#247;</mo></math> (iii)

<math><mfrac><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2.4</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>0.6</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow></msup></math>

<math><mn>4</mn><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow></msup></math>

<math><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></math>

The order of reaction w.r.t. <math><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> and w.r.t. <math><mi>B</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></math>

Total order of reaction <math><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></math></p></blockquote>

</details>

### Q16. JEE Main 2018 (08 Apr)

*Type:* `singleCorrect` | *Difficulty Level:* `2`

At <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>518</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mo>,</mo></math> the rate of decomposition of a sample of gaseous acetaldehyde, initially at a pressure of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>363</mn><mtext>&#8201;</mtext><mi>Torr</mi></math> was <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>.00</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">&#160;</mi><mi>Torr</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">&#160;</mi><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> when <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> had reacted and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.50</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">&#160;</mi><mi>Torr</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">&#160;</mi><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> when 33% had reacted. The order of the reaction is:

**Options:**

- **(A)** <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn></math>
- **(B)** <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn></math>
- **(C)** <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn></math>
- **(D)** <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn></math>

<details>
<summary><b>View Answer & Solution</b></summary>

**Correct Option:** **(B) <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn></math>**

**Detailed Solution:**

<p>Rate<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>&#8733;</mo><msup><mfenced separators="|"><mi>concentration</mi></mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></msup></math>

Let the initial concentration be <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>&#160;</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi></math>.</p><p>According to the question,</p><p><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable><mtr><mtd><mi>Concentration</mi></mtd><mtd><mo>&#160;</mo><mo>&#160;</mo><mi>Rate</mi></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>95</mn><mo>&#160;</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi></mtd><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>67</mn><mo>&#160;</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi></mtd><mtd><mo>&#160;</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></math></p><p>Substituting in the general rate expression,</p><p><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced separators="|"><mfrac><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>.95</mo></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>.67</mo></mrow></mfrac></mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></msup><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>.5</mo></mrow></mfrac></math></p><p><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>&#8658;</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></math></p>

</details>
